## Cotiviti Search — AI Guidance

- Architecture: Next.js 16 App Router; Hono drives all /api routes via hono/vercel in [app/api/[[...route]]/route.ts](../app/api/[[...route]]/route.ts); Drizzle over libsql/SQLite for persistence; Okta auth; Azure OpenAI models in [lib/llm.ts](../lib/llm.ts).
- Auth/session: Client signs in with Okta then POSTs /api/login to set an HS256 `session` cookie (aud `cotiviti-search-session`, 7d TTL) via [lib/session.ts](../lib/session.ts); logout clears it. Keep new protected endpoints inside [app/api/[[...route]]/\_authRoutes.ts](../app/api/[[...route]]/_authRoutes.ts) so `obtainUserData` attaches `c.var.user`.
- API pattern: Hono app is mounted under `/api`; export handlers with `handle(app)` for each verb. Return JSON; for streaming use `streamText` with SSE chunks as shown in `/chat`.
- Data model: `sessions.type` = `chat` or `apc`; `sections` link sessions to `chat` rows; `messages` store content + optional docs; feedback in `message_feedback`; highlights in `highlighted_text` ([db/schemas.ts](../db/schemas.ts)). Prefer helpers in [lib/db.ts](../lib/db.ts) to enforce ownership and cascading deletes.
- Chat flow: Client `ChatProvider` posts `/api/chat` with `sessionId`; server builds context from stored messages, verifies last message is `user`, streams `{type:"content"}` SSE then `{type:"messageId"}` after `updateChatMessageContent` finishes. Assistant message row is pre-created via `addToChatSessionMessage`; keep this shape when adding features.
- Research (APC) flow: `createResearch` server action produces tagged sections; `/api/create-research` stores them with `createResearchSession`, writing assistant messages per section. UI lives under `(auth-protected)/apc-research`.
- CPT lookup: `/api/cpt-codes` wraps `fetchCptCodes` and returns `cpt_codes_and_descriptions` (five items); keep response contract stable for UI.
- Navigation: `getUserChatHistory` returns up to 40 sessions with URLs for chat or APC; consumed by Zustand store in [stores/userProfileSlice.ts](../stores/userProfileSlice.ts) during login and refresh.
- State management: `createUserProfileStore` handles Okta redirect parsing (`authClient.token.parseFromUrl`) and POST /api/login, tracks `loading` to block duplicate calls. `ChatProvider` owns streaming state, `AbortController`, and appends messages while deduping by `id`.
- LLM config: Allowed `AVAILABLE_MODELS` in [lib/llm.ts](../lib/llm.ts) with per-deployment env keys (gpt-4.1, gpt-5 variants, medgemma). Use `queryllmStream` for SSE and `queryllm` + `zodResponseFormat` for structured outputs; fail fast if model not in allowlist.
- Env/setup: Require `SESSION_JWT_SECRET`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_AUTH_OKTA_ISSUER`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_AUTH_OKTA_ID`, Azure OpenAI keys/endpoints per model, optional `DB_URL` (path joined then converted to file URL in [lib/db.ts](../lib/db.ts)). Missing values break auth or model calls.
- Workflows: `npm run dev` for local; migrations via `drizzle-kit generate` then `drizzle-kit push`. Default DB file is `sqlite.db` when `DB_URL` unset.
- Server-only boundaries: `lib/session.ts` and `lib/oktaServer.ts` are `server-only`; never import them into client components.
- Notes/highlights: Use `getSessionNotes`/`updateSessionNotes` and highlight helpers in [lib/db.ts](../lib/db.ts); combined endpoint `/session/:sessionId/notes-highlights` checks session ownership via Okta user.
- Session utilities: `createChatSession` derives topic from first user message substring (max 20 chars); `updateChatTopic`/`deleteChatSession` re-check ownership and cascade deletes across sections/messages/chats.
- UI patterns: Tailwind + Radix primitives in `components/`; authenticated routes live under `(auth-protected)/chat-research` and `/apc-research`; keep server-only imports out of client files.
- Prompting: When extending prompts/models, keep the existing tagged format (`<SECTION_N>`, `<TITLE>`, `<CONTENT>`) for predictable parsing and reuse `queryllm` helpers.
